reply.emotion: craving and satisfied, tasting something sweet and rich
notes: In Mexico and many Spanish-speaking countries, chocolate can also refer to a warm, thick hot chocolate drink often prepared with water or milk and cinnamon.

senses.definition: Alimento dulce hecho con cacao y azúcar, que suele tener forma de tableta.

examples.text: Me gusta comer un trozo de chocolate después de cenar.
examples.translation: I like to eat a piece of chocolate after dinner.
examples.emotion: relaxed and content, enjoying a small evening treat

senses.definition: Bebida caliente o fría preparada con cacao y leche o agua.

examples.text: En las mañanas frías me preparo un chocolate caliente.
examples.translation: On cold mornings I make myself a hot chocolate.
examples.emotion: cozy and warm, comforting oneself against the cold
